# Screenshot 1: "Cleaned, pressed — and made to fit" (Alterations Section)

**A) Image Fit:** **Excellent.** The image of the seamstress at her workstation is perfectly composed for this section. She is centered in a well-lit, professional workspace with garments visible in the background, directly illustrating the tailoring/alterations service described in the copy. The framing captures her hands working on fabric with tools (scissors, thread spools) visible on the table—exactly what you'd expect from an alterations context.

**B) Premium Feel & Brand Consistency: **Strong.** The image conveys craftsmanship and expertise. The deep navy blue wall in the background aligns perfectly with the brand's navy/gold color palette. The warm lighting, professional setting, and focused expression of the tailor communicate quality and attention to detail appropriate for a premium service. The gold measuring tape around her neck subtly reinforces the brand accent color.

**C) Layout Issues: **None detected.** Clean two-column layout with text on left, image on right. Generous whitespace, no text overlap, no image stretching or distortion. The rounded corners on the image container add a modern, polished touch. The "In-house tailor" label overlay is positioned cleanly without obscuring important visual elements.

**D) Verdict: **SHIP** ✅

---

# Screenshot 2: "Care for everything you wear" (Delivery/Service Section)

**A) Image Fit: **Perfect match.** The image shows exactly what was requested: a rider/delivery person in a sharp navy uniform handing a navy laundry bag with a prominent gold "K" logo to a customer at what appears to be a residential doorway. This visually reinforces the convenience and white-glove service aspect of the brand.

**B) Premium Feel & Brand Consistency: **Exceptional.** This is where the navy/gold luxury positioning really shines. The rider's tailored navy uniform with gold buttons mirrors high-end hotel concierge or private club aesthetics. The navy bag with the elegant gold serif "K" is prominently displayed and looks expensive. The customer's interaction (smiling, receiving the bag) suggests trust and satisfaction. The residential setting with warm interior lighting suggests this is a premium home service.

**C) Layout Issues: **None detected.** The layout is flipped from Screenshot 1 (image left, text right), creating good visual rhythm if these appear sequentially. The three metric cards (24h, ₦500+, 10%) are evenly spaced and aligned. The footer begins below with proper hierarchy. No cropping issues—the subjects are fully visible with appropriate breathing room.

**D) Verdict: **SHIP** ✅

---

## Overall Assessment
Both screenshots represent **production-ready, premium-quality web design**. The photography is consistent in tone (warm, professional, trustworthy), the navy/gold branding is executed flawlessly across both imagery and UI elements, and the layouts are clean with no technical defects. These successfully position Kozy Care as a luxury/concierge-level laundry service rather than a commodity cleaner.
